# AI Diploma Learning Hub

Static GitHub Pages website for the AI Diploma class.

## Weekly updates
Edit `data.js` for:
- Group names and members
- Quiz, mini lab, and explanation scores
- Badges and achievements
- Current course resources
- General AI resources
- Best explanation gallery
- AI Word of the Week
- AI Experts
- Announcements
- Google Form links

## Do not edit unless needed
- `index.html`: page structure
- `style.css`: design/colors
- `script.js`: logic/calculations


Version: v3-logo. Includes tuwaiq-logo.png in the website header.
